final_answer_text:
Here is your health picture, kept carefully inside what the chart can honestly support — and I want to say up front that **none of this is a diagnosis.** These are classical watch-indications, not medical findings, and nothing here should displace a doctor.

**Your constitutional pattern.**
Two placements carry *strong* classical health signatures in your chart:
- **Moon in Aquarius, Puṛva Bhādrapada nakṣatra** — aggravating **kapha and vāta**, with the classical watch falling on **mind, lungs and stomach**. This is your birth-Moon, which makes it the single most load-bearing health signature you have. In practical terms: the classical reading of this configuration is a nervous system that carries stress somatically, and a respiratory/digestive axis worth protecting.
- **Sun in Capricorn, Śravaṇa nakṣatra** — aggravating **pitta**, watch on **heart, eyes and spine**.

At moderate strength: **Mercury in Capricorn** flags a **tridoṣa** disturbance with the watch on **nervous system, skin, tongue and hands**; **Mars in Libra** on **marrow and red blood cells** (pitta); **Venus** on **kidneys and reproductive**. Milder: Saturn on **teeth, bones, joints, large intestine** — the classical vāta-and-structure pattern that typically asserts itself from midlife onward. All of these trace to BPHS Ch.18 cross-read with Charaka Saṃhitā and Aṣṭāṅga Hṛdayam.

I will flag one connection the system did not make for me: **Mercury's watch includes the tongue and the nervous system**, and your own life record notes a congenital speech pattern. Classically those sit in the same significator. I offer that as a coherence observation, not as a cause.

**The one structural weak point.** In the **Ṣaṣṭhāṃśa (D6)** — the divisional chart for disease and affliction — **Mars is debilitated**, and it sits in the 2nd house of that chart. Everything else in D6 is dignity-neutral. So the D6 does not show a broadly afflicted constitution; it shows one specific weak lever, and that lever is Mars — which is also the lord of your Aries lagna. Blood, inflammation, and pitta-driven acute episodes are the classical reading of a weak Mars in the D6.

**Timing — and here I must be careful with you.**
The transit sweep returns **17 forward health windows over the next three years: 11 adverse, 6 neutral, and none favourable.** The five strongest are all classed `illness_acute` and are served as **single calendar days**: 21 Aug 2027, 21 Nov 2028, 13 Dec 2028, 13 Apr 2029, 18 Jul 2029.

**I am not going to pass those to you as predictions, and you should not treat them as such.** A single-day acute-illness date two and three years out is a precision the underlying method cannot support. They arrive with no probability attached, no confidence interval, and no calibration behind them — the system's own tier for all its timing output here is *structural prior, pre-calibration*, meaning zero recorded outcomes have ever tested it. What the cluster reasonably supports is a **directional** statement: **2028–2029 carries more health pressure in this chart than 2026–2027 does.** That is the honest resolution of that data. The dates themselves are noise dressed as signal.

**Two further honest limits.**
- Unlike your career reading, **no classical yoga in your chart bears on health specifically.** Thirteen yogas fired; none name your 1st/6th/8th lords or the Sun as kāraka. So there is no strong yoga-level verdict either way — neither a protective āyur-yoga nor an affliction yoga.
- Your chart carries an **unresolved contradiction tagged to health** (`domain_promise_vs_denial`) with no automated adjudication. Two comparable-weight signals disagree about your vitality. That is a genuine open question in your chart, not something I can close for you.

**Bottom line.** Constitutionally: a kapha-vāta Moon and a pitta Sun, with nervous-system and respiratory/digestive sensitivity as the recurring theme, plus a weak Mars in the disease-varga pointing at inflammatory and blood-related susceptibility. No catastrophic signature. **2028–2029 is the stretch to be attentive in.** Everything timing-related here is low-confidence, and I would rather tell you that than sell you five dates.
